## ✨ Highlights

- 📈 **The Janus exporter** - every node now serves its own Prometheus metrics on `:10056`: certificate expiry, HAProxy restarts and crashes, SELinux denials, clock sync, API calls... - what HAProxy's and node_exporter's metrics don't tell you. On by default.
- 🧱 **Three new extensions**: a **firewall** (nftables), **VRRP** (keepalived) and **BGP** (BIRD), each configured through the API, `janusctl` and the Controller.
- 🩺 **Failover that follows HAProxy** - a node whose HAProxy stops answering gives its VRRP virtual IPs up and withdraws its anycast routes, and takes them back when HAProxy answers again.
- 🔐 **Uploaded certificates stay** - certificates uploaded to HAProxy at runtime now survive reloads, restarts and reboots.

## 📈 Janus exporter

- Plain HTTP on **`:10056/metrics`** - the first port free after the Prometheus exporters' allocations - on by default, settings kept across reboots and upgrades: `janusctl system metrics [-port N] [-enable|-disable]`, or the Controller's **Monitoring › Metrics**.
- Metrics about the node *as Janus runs it*, not duplicating HAProxy's or node_exporter's: release, schematic and boot slot; expiry of the API's certificates and of every certificate HAProxy has loaded; HAProxy up, reloads, unexpected exits, config applies; extension services; NTP sync and offset; network and firewall trials; SELinux mode and denials; kernel OOM kills; STATE filesystem errors; API calls by method and code; firewall sets, VRRP instances and BGP sessions.
- Like node_exporter, it has no authentication: restrict who reaches the port. [Metrics reference and ready-made alerts](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/metrics.md).

## 🧱 Firewall - the `nftables` extension

- nftables 1.1.7. The node's whole ruleset, in nft's own syntax, managed with `janusctl network firewall check|apply|confirm` or the Controller's **Apps › Firewall**.
- **Applied on trial**: unless it's confirmed over a *new* connection within 30 seconds (5-300), the node puts the previous ruleset back by itself - a ruleset that locks you out undoes itself.
- **Named sets edited live** (the ipset use case): `janusctl network firewall set-add|set-del [-timeout 1h] inet filter blocklist 192.0.2.7`. Elements added without a timeout are kept across applies and reboots.
- The kernel gained nf_tables with connection tracking, NAT, `log`, `reject`, `limit`, `quota`, `synproxy` and `socket`/`tproxy` for HAProxy's transparent proxying. [Guide](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/firewall.md).

## 🔀 VRRP - the `keepalived` extension

- keepalived 2.3.4, built for VRRP only. Your own `keepalived.conf`: `janusctl network vrrp check|apply|get|status`, or the Controller's **Apps › VRRP** - keepalived checks it before anything is replaced, then reloads.
- **HAProxy's health**: track `/run/janus/keepalived/haproxy-health` (`track_file`, `weight 0`) and an instance gives its virtual IPs up while this node's HAProxy doesn't answer - or is being stopped. keepalived can't run check scripts on a node without a shell; janusd keeps that file.
- `status` shows each instance's state, priority, virtual IPs and last transition. [Guide](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/vrrp.md).

## 🛰️ BGP - the `bird` extension

- BIRD 2.19.2: BGP, OSPF, BFD, static routes. Your own `bird.conf`: `janusctl network bgp check|apply|get|status`, or the Controller's **Apps › BGP** - BIRD checks it before anything is replaced, then reconfigures; sessions whose configuration doesn't change stay up.
- **Anycast with HAProxy**: protocols named `haproxy_*` are kept down while this node's HAProxy doesn't answer - put your anycast address in a `haproxy_*` static protocol and export it, and it leaves the network with HAProxy.
- BGP session passwords (TCP MD5) and BFD work; BIRD's messages are its service's log (`janusctl system logs bird`).
- `status` lists every protocol: state, BGP neighbor and AS, last error, routes in and out. [Guide](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/bgp.md).
- With the firewall, accept what these need: `tcp dport 179` for BGP, `ip protocol 112` for VRRP.

## ⚖️ HAProxy

- **Certificates uploaded at runtime are kept**: `CertificateUpload` (`janusctl haproxy cert-upload`, the Controller's certificate page) stores the certificate - and its crt-list binding - on the node, and janusd puts it back into HAProxy after every reload, restart and reboot. `CertificateDelete` removes it for good.
- Runtime commands sent right after a reload or a config apply reach the new HAProxy, not the one being replaced.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **Apps › Firewall**, **Apps › VRRP** and **Apps › BGP**: live state, and the configuration in an editor that the daemon itself checks, with the diff shown before anything is applied.
- **Monitoring › Metrics**: the exporter's settings.

## 🐛 Fixes

- After an `ApplyConfig`, a certificate upload or other runtime command could fail with "No ongoing transaction", having reached the HAProxy being replaced.
- HAProxy being stopped (soft stop: listeners closed, the process still finishing connections) no longer counts as healthy.
- A node powered off seconds after announcing itself to its Controller no longer announces itself again on its next boot.
- A slot on trial after an upgrade (`wait_for_health`) whose boot crashed early could be retried instead of reverted: the attempt is now on disk before the slot starts.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- Nothing to do: the exporter starts on `:10056` after the upgrade. Turn it off with `janusctl system metrics -disable` if you don't want it, or block the port.
- The firewall, VRRP and BGP come with their extensions: build an image with them on [janus.sw-servers.net](https://janus.sw-servers.net) and upgrade to its bundle with `-allow-schematic-change` (or install it). A node without an extension reports it as not enabled.
